exercises.why: **уговорим** — уговори́ть (perfective): to persuade, to talk (into), to urge. Wiktionary: у- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (intransitive) to speak, to talk, to converse (with)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: говори́ть — to speak, to talk (perfective поговорить); проговори́ть — to say, to utter; заговори́ть — to begin to speak; разгова́ривать — (intransitive) to speak, to talk, to converse (with).
**уговорил** — уговори́ть (perfective): to persuade, to talk (into), to urge. Wiktionary: у- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Don't ever talk to me again.
exercises.why: **заговаривай** — загова́ривать (imperfective): to begin to talk; to tire (someone) with one's talk, to talk someone's ear off; to exorcise, to cast a spell. Wiktionary: заговори́ть + -ивать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Are you scared to talk to girls?
exercises.why: **заговаривать** — загова́ривать (imperfective): to begin to talk; to tire (someone) with one's talk, to talk someone's ear off; to exorcise, to cast a spell. Wiktionary: заговори́ть + -ивать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: It is difficult for the Japanese to articulate the sound of the r.
exercises.why: **выговаривать** — выгова́ривать (imperfective): to articulate, to pronounce, to utter; (colloquial) to tell off, to reprimand, to lecture; (colloquial) to reserve for oneself. Wiktionary: вы́говорить + -ивать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Daniel has been giving Linda a lot of grief about her reckless spending.
exercises.ru: Дэниэл много раз ___ Линде за её неуёмные траты.
exercises.why: **выговаривал** — выгова́ривать (imperfective): to articulate, to pronounce, to utter; (colloquial) to tell off, to reprimand, to lecture; (colloquial) to reserve for oneself. Wiktionary: вы́говорить + -ивать.

exercises.why: **переговорю** — переговори́ть (perfective): to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with); (colloquial) to discuss, to cover; (colloquial) to talk down, to outtalk. Wiktionary: пере- + говори́ть.

exercises.q: I said something I shouldn't have.
exercises.why: **наговорил** — наговори́ть (perfective): to record, to read for recording, to have one's reading recorded; (colloquial) to slander; to say, to tell (a lot); to bewitch. Wiktionary: на- + говори́ть.
